player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in SimpleTak.
On the board, your stones appear as '{player_stone}' and your opponent's stones appear as '{opponent_stone}'.

On your turn, choose one empty cell (by its numbered index) and place your stone there.
For example, '[12]' places your stone in cell 12.

Your objective is to form a continuous path of your stones that connects two opposite edges of the board (top-to-bottom or left-to-right).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: अमान्य कोष्ठक संख्या {cell_num}। ० और {max_board_num} के बीच होना चाहिए।
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: {cell_num} कोष्ठं विद्यमानम् अस्ति। रिक्तकोष्ठं चकार भवतु ।

action.placement: खिलाड़ी {current_player_id} ने अपना प्रतीक ({symbol}) कोष्ठक {cell_num} में रखा।

outcome.winner: खिलाड़ी {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') ने दो विपरीत किनारों को जोड़ा!
outcome.draw: पटलः पूर्णम् अस्ति। इदमेव बद्धं भवति!
